screening.basis: Art. 50(1): the system interacts directly with natural persons; no Annex III use
obligations: Art. 50(1): users must be told they are interacting with an AI system. Verified at runtime by the TRANSPARENCY check.
conditions: GDPR Art. 9 special-category (health) data is processed: complete a data protection impact assessment (GDPR Art. 35) before production.

Works council: the audit trail could be used to monitor individual handlers, so co-determination applies (BetrVG §87(1) no. 6). Agree a works agreement before production; logs are pseudonymised already.
notes: Scope trigger: using the assistant for risk assessment or pricing in life or health insurance would make it high-risk (Annex III point 5(c)). Re-run this screening on every scope change.
Settlements need a human approval step, so no decision is solely automated (GDPR Art. 22).
Screening aid, not legal advice. Several AI Act application dates changed in 2026 (Digital Omnibus); confirm the current dates on EUR-Lex with the client's legal team.

scenarios.question: A pipe under the kitchen sink burst and soaked the laminate floor. Is that covered under Hausrat Comfort, and can I settle a 3,400 EUR claim on my own authority?
scenarios.answer: Hausrat Comfort covers water damage caused by burst pipes, including damage to laminate floors under the kitchen sink. You may settle property claims up to 5,000 EUR on your own authority, so a 3,400 EUR claim is within your settlement authority [KB-HR-AVB#water-damage-escape-of-tap-water] [KB-PROP-GUIDE#settlement-authority].

scenarios.question: What must be in the claim file before I can settle a burglary claim?
scenarios.answer: Before settling a burglary claim, the claim file must include photos of the damage, an invoice or cost estimate, the police report reference number, and a list of stolen items. scenarios.question: The weather service measured wind force 7 at the address when roof tiles fell onto the garden furniture. Does storm cover apply?
scenarios.answer: Storm cover requires wind force of at least 8 on the Beaufort scale. Wind force 7 is not considered storm damage, so the policy would not cover damage from roof tiles falling due to wind force 7. Storm cover applies only from wind force 8 or if nearby buildings are damaged by the wind at the location [KB-HR-AVB#storm-and-hail].

scenarios.question: When do we waive the underinsurance deduction on a home contents claim?
scenarios.answer: For Hausrat Comfort home contents insurance, Contoso waives the underinsurance deduction if the sum insured is at least 650 EUR per square metre of living area at the time of the loss. If this threshold is not met, the payout is reduced proportionally to the sum insured versus the actual value of the contents [KB-HR-AVB#underinsurance-waiver].

scenarios.question: A basement was flooded after heavy rain. Is that covered, and is there a deductible?
scenarios.answer: Flooding of a basement due to heavy rain is covered only if the policy includes the natural hazards add-on (Elementarschaden-Baustein) to the Hausrat insurance. This add-on covers damages from flooding including heavy rain (Starkregen). There is a deductible (Selbstbehalt) of 500 EUR per claim. Coverage starts after a waiting period of one month from the start of the add-on. Without this add-on, flooding from rain is not covered under the standard Hausrat Comfort policy (home contents insurance) [KB-ELEMENTAR-DE#versicherte-gefahren, KB-ELEMENTAR-DE#selbstbehalt-und-wartezeit, KB-HR-AVB#insured-perils].

scenarios.question: The policyholder e-mailed new bank details for the payout. Can I just update the IBAN and pay?
scenarios.answer: Payouts must be made only to the IBAN on file for the policyholder. Any request to change bank details requires confirmation by a callback to the phone number on file and written confirmation from the policyholder. scenarios.question: Repair costs are 125% of the car's replacement value. Can the customer still have it repaired at our expense?
scenarios.answer: If repair costs are 125% of the car's replacement value, the customer can still have it repaired at Contoso's expense. This is allowed as long as the repair costs do not exceed 130% of the replacement value, the repair is done professionally as per the expert report, and the owner uses the vehicle for at least six months afterwards. Above 130%, Contoso pays the replacement value minus the residual value instead [KB-MOTOR-GUIDE#repair-or-total-loss-130-percent-rule].

scenarios.question: When should a burglary claim be referred to SIU?
scenarios.answer: Refer a burglary claim to the Special Investigations Unit (SIU) when 3 or more red flags are present. Red flags include no signs of forced entry, sum insured increased within the last 6 months, claim within 90 days of policy start, high-value items without receipts, inconsistent police report, and previous similar claims. Do not inform the policyholder about the referral. A fraud score above 70 also triggers an SIU investigation. The policyholder must report the burglary to the police promptly and provide a police report reference number for settlement. [KB-SIU-PLAYBOOK#referral-rule, KB-SIU-PLAYBOOK#red-flags-for-staged-burglary, KB-SIU-PLAYBOOK#fraud-score-thresholds, KB-HR-AVB#burglary]

productionPath: Identity: replace development personas with Microsoft Entra ID sign-in (Microsoft.Identity.Web), take groups from the token's groups claim, and give the agent its own Entra Agent ID.

Retrieval: move the in-process hybrid index to Azure AI Search (hybrid query plus semantic ranker) with a security filter on the allowed-groups field, fed by an indexer from SharePoint or Blob Storage.

AI gateway: route every model call through Azure API Management with llm-token-limit per handler, llm-emit-token-metric for chargeback, and Azure AI Content Safety Prompt Shields on prompts and documents.
Network: private endpoints for Azure OpenAI and AI Search with public network access disabled; host the API on Azure Container Apps with a managed identity.
Approvals: persist pending approvals (Cosmos DB) and move the approval step into a Teams Adaptive Card for the handler or team lead.
Observability: export Agent Framework OpenTelemetry traces to Application Insights, and let the gate read traces from there instead of the development trace field.
CI: run this gate on every pull request that changes prompts, models, tools or the index (GitHub Actions with OIDC federation to Azure, no stored secrets).
Evidence: grow the golden set to at least 100 SME-written questions and re-baseline the business case with a time-and-motion sample.
